integrity: General formulas proved by explicit reachable residual classification and distinguishing suffixes. Finite checker corroborates 384 automata and 196584 word comparisons; computations alone do not prove the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Exact classical complete deterministic left-to-right state counts only for binary alphabet, d>=2, k>=1. No claim on other forbidden patterns or nondeterministic automata. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed sources.
title: An unbounded reversal gap for constrained subsequence-universality automata
